heading: Fines on ocean carriers
lead: The Postal Service may impose or remit fines on carriers transporting mail by vessel on routes extending beyond the borders of the United States for—

tree.text: unreasonable or unnecessary delay to the mails; and
other delinquencies in the transportation of mail.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective July 1, 1971, pursuant to Resolution No. 71–9 of the Board of Governors. See section 15(a) of Pub. L. 91–375, set out as a note preceding section 101 of this title.
